Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，The time noun is redundant with the “……的时候” pattern; use the shorter time expression. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，This refers to a group of people in ancient times, so use the plural/group noun rather than the generic noun. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，Here the mother perceives the effect; “看到了” means “saw/noticed,” while “看” means intentionally looking. [vocab list]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：孟子和妈妈搬家了，The mother was just mentioned, so use the close re-occurrence form instead of repeating Mengzi’s name inside the same noun phrase. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 老是对他开玩笑了：老是对他开玩笑，This describes a repeated habit, so it takes the zero particle rather than completed-action “了”. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
6. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。：因为他每天只祭拜，所以没有朋友。These ideas express cause and effect, so use the paired cause-and-effect connector rather than an unfinished contrast connector. [rule: coherence_connectives]

items.reason: “古代的时候” redundantly uses a time noun together with “的时候”; “在古代” is correct.
This refers to a concrete group of people, so “人们” is required rather than generic “人”.
“看到了” correctly changes intentional looking to noticing, but the displayed correction still lacks “有” in “同学们对孟子有不好的影响”.
Replacing the repeated “孟子妈妈” with “妈妈” is a correct close-reference repair in this noun phrase.
A habitual action introduced by “老是” should not take completed-action “了”.
The original incorrectly combines “虽然” with “因为”; the revised 因为……所以 structure correctly expresses cause and result.
